Hey Bestie!

Thanks for reaching out to us.

I would love to help you locate your tracking information right away! Could you please share your order number and the email address or phone number used at checkout? 🙂

If you have any more questions, feel free to ask.

turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Orders are typically shipped from our Toronto warehouse within 1 to 2 business days.

Once your package ships, you'll automatically receive a tracking link via email or SMS. Please note that tracking updates can take up to 3 business days to start showing movement after shipment.

Feel free to share your order number whenever you have a moment so I can look into your specific order for you! 🙂

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Standard delivery typically takes 3 to 7 business days for orders within the US and Canada. For international shipments, delivery generally takes 15 to 20 business days.

Please feel free to share your order number whenever you are ready so I can take a closer look for you. 🙂

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
Tracking updates can occasionally take up to 3 business days to start showing movement after your package ships.

If your tracking information does not update for 8 or more days after a carrier scan, please reach out to us with your order number so we can look into it and assist you. 🙂
